title: Successful login from 203.0.113.45 following brute force
description: User 'root' successfully authenticated from 203.0.113.45 at 2026-08-30T03:14:52+00:00, within 300s of a brute-force burst from the same IP. The account should be treated as potentially compromised.
recommended_action: Force a password reset for the account, invalidate active sessions, and review actions taken by this login for further lateral movement.

title: Large outbound transfer 10.0.0.14 -> 198.51.100.200
description: 75,000,000 bytes sent from internal host 10.0.0.14 to external host 198.51.100.200 over tcp/443 at 2026-08-30T23:47:12+00:00 (outside business hours).
recommended_action: Confirm the transfer was expected (backup job, approved sync). If not, isolate the host and inspect for exfiltration tooling or a compromised process.

title: SSH brute force from 203.0.113.45
description: 5 failed SSH password attempts from 203.0.113.45 within 120s, targeting user(s): admin, root.
recommended_action: Block or rate-limit the source IP, confirm targeted accounts were not compromised, and review fail2ban / SSH key-only auth policy.

title: Possible port scan: 203.0.113.45 -> 10.0.0.5
recommended_action: Verify whether this is an authorized vulnerability scan; if not, block the source at the perimeter and review what, if anything, responded.

mitre_technique: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Sudo and Sudo Caching
title: Sudo failure(s) then success for user 'hans'
description: User 'hans' had 2 sudo authentication failure(s) followed by a successful command ('/usr/sbin/useradd -m svc-backup') within 600s.
recommended_action: Confirm the command was authorized by the account owner; if not, treat the session as compromised and audit sudoers configuration.
